posts.text: Shipped our public beta this morning. Six months of building, three pivots, two near-deaths, one live product. Link in bio. If you're a DevOps engineer drowning in alert fatigue, this is for you.
First ten paying customers in 48 hours. None of them were on the waitlist. All of them came through a single Hacker News comment. Pipeline strategy is fake until it works.
Trying to figure out how to do outbound now that we have something to sell. Every tool I look at assumes I have a SDR team. I don't. I have me and a Postgres connection.
